records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Studio!
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

draft.subject: Getting Silver Studio's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Great to talk last week. Since then I noticed Silver Studio hasn't created a first project yet, so I wanted to check in before things get busy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that first project is usually the fastest way to see value. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through the first project with you and answer anything along the way.

Best,
Priya
